summary: Completed testing of Kosmo Evidence Fix and 12 operational adjustments. All 7 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: Kosmo proof URLs showing as camera icons, Revisado column with review buttons, Driver column in Dashboard, Kosmo sync 10-min text, VISITAS header, auto-calculated close metrics.

Kosmo_Evidence_Fix_Async_Sync.details: POST /api/sync/tracking returns immediately with {status: 'started'} instead of waiting for all packages. Verified response time < 5 seconds.

Kosmo_Proof_URLs_In_Packages.details: Journey detail API returns packages with kosmo_proof_urls array. Database has 488 packages with proof URLs. Journey 51d80f44-85c7-4ddb-a932-40e49b7d8fd6 has 7 packages with proof URLs.

Evidencias_Column_Camera_Icons.details: Packages table shows Evidencias column with clickable camera icons linking to proof photos. Found 17 camera icon proof links in UI.

Revisado_Column_Review_Buttons.details: Packages table shows Revisado column with circle icons (unreviewed) and checkmark icons (reviewed). Found 52 unreviewed and 2 reviewed packages.

Package_Review_API.details: PUT /api/packages/{package_id}/review saves reviewed_by and reviewed_at fields. Verified persistence in database.

Resolve_All_Incidents_API.details: PUT /api/incidents/journey/{journey_id}/resolve-all resolves all open incidents. Requires coordinator/agent role.

Dashboard_Driver_Column.details: Dashboard journeys table shows 'Driver' column with driver names like 'Raymundo Enríquez', 'Jaime J.', 'Brian D.', 'JORGE O.', 'Miguel Q.'

Kosmo_Sync_10min_Text.details: Dashboard shows 'Sincronización Kosmo (cada 10 min)' text in sync bar.

VISITAS_Header_Card.details: Journey detail header shows 'VISITAS' card with count of delivered+failed+returned packages (52 intentos registrados).

Close_Route_Auto_Calculated.details: Close route form shows auto-calculated read-only values: ENTREGADOS (50), FALLIDOS (3), DEVOLUCIONES (1).

Evidence_Quality_Scoring.details: Packages have evidence_score field. Soporte column shows Completo/Parcial/Incompleto badges. Quality tab shows average score (12%).

Sync_Status_Endpoint.details: GET /api/sync/status returns last_sync, total_checked, updated, errors fields.

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing journey 51d80f44-85c7-4ddb-a932-40e49b7d8fd6 with 54 packages.
